exercises.question: Which sentence contains advice followed by the present subjunctive? [¿Cuál contiene un consejo seguido del presente de subjuntivo?]
options: Te recomiendo que descanses unos días. [I recommend that you rest for a few days.]
Te recomiendo descansar unos días. [I recommend resting for a few days.]
Descansas unos días. [You rest for a few days.]

exercises.sentence: Te recomiendo que __ unos días. [I recommend that you rest for a few days.] (descansar)

exercises.english: It is important that you exercise regularly.

exercises.question: Which form is correct after «el médico aconseja que»? [¿Qué forma es correcta después de «el médico aconseja que»?]
options: bebas más agua [you drink more water]
bebes más agua [you drink more water]
beber más agua [to drink more water]

exercises.sentence: El médico aconseja que __ más agua. [The doctor advises that you drink more water.] (beber)
